subtitle: Introduction to Computers
educationalGoal: Students will learn the basics of how information is represented on computers and computer hardware, software, and networks.
advice: This is a basic introduction course to computers. We will cover the following topics: 1. How information is represented on computers 2. Computer hardware 3. Computer software 4. Computer networks Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and be aware of this information during class because the course schedule and content may change depending on the progress of the class.
